svg.title: What an operator can deploy, beside 24 agent sessions
svg.desc: For each of 7 configurations beside 24 agent sessions of the traces with the largest contexts, at the median of its runs, its voice-to-voice p95 against the SLO of 2.02 s and the agents' tokens a second over the calls, only the lifecycle policy over make-room and the configuration to deploy within 0.2 s of the SLO, every other 0.5 s or more over it: tuned vLLM 10.14 s at 3,710 tokens/s; 1,024-token steps 8.79 s at 4,097 tokens/s; a token reservation 5.67 s at 3,564 tokens/s; SGLang with HiCache 11.95 s at 4,723 tokens/s; preempt-resubmit 2.59 s, 0.57 s over the SLO, at 3,630 tokens/s; the lifecycle policy over make-room 2.06 s, 0.04 s over the SLO, at 3,411 tokens/s; and the configuration to deploy 2.19 s, 0.18 s over the SLO, at 3,493 tokens/s.
